newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Medarex upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Medarex upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc Thursday upgraded Medarex Inc to buy based on its "excellent progress" in 1996.

-- Analyst Peter Ginsberg said Medarex can no longer be considered a venture-stage company now that it has a series of drug candidates in advanced clinical trials, four partners and more than $30 million in cash in hand.
-- Ginsberg also initiated a new price target for Medarex of $15, up from $12 a share.
-- Its shares were unchanged Thursday at eight.
